policy.rule: No matched KEEP path is publishable until public-candidate verification passes. PRIVATE paths are excluded by default.

rationale..agents/: agent prompts may encode operational/strategy assumptions; reintroduce only after public-safe review
rationale..claude/: agent commands may encode operational/strategy assumptions; reintroduce only after public-safe review
rationale.data/: research/runtime/evidence datasets are private by default
rationale.deploy/: deployment topology and service configuration are private by default
rationale.docs/: historical audit, handoff, runtime, strategy, and operational documentation is private by default
rationale.ops/: operational and box-management tooling is private by default
rationale.research/: strategy research and evidence are private by default
rationale.scripts/: mixed research/ops/admin tooling; selectively reintroduce only after review

publication_gates: sanitize all REVIEW files before inclusion
run secret scan on exported tree
run public-operational-detail scan on exported tree
run tests against candidate and document missing private-only dependencies
verify no private/runtime evidence was copied
create new repository from candidate tree with no inherited refs/history
configure rulesets/branch protection before normal development
do not change source repository visibility
